request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

limitations: Device map snapshots are observed; per-kernel launch counts remain source-predicted.
Decode-only maps are unused; only their shape is validated.
Window membership retains the 2 ms clock tolerance.
Padding is not useful F; full stream closure and model arithmetic coverage remain separate requirements.
